# Objective

- Clarifies `spawn`, `spawn_batch` and `ParallelCommands` docs about performance and use cases

## Solution

intended use case and link to other/better ways of doing spawning things for

issue_context.title: Tell users not to use `ParallelCommands` for spawning entities en-masse
issue_context.body:
When spawning large batches of entities, use `spawn_batch`, not `ParallelCommands`. `ParallelCommands` increases per-command overhead, and is suited to computation-heavy tasks. By contrast, `spawn_batch` collects all of the work to be done and dramatically reduces the amount of computation and allocations required.

You can further reduce overhead by using an exclusive system, to avoid the indirection of commands, but `spawn_batch` is by far the most important optimization.

_Originally posted by @alice-i-cecile in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/discussions/15471#discussioncomment-10776308_
comments: IMO this sort of warning is best added to `ParallelCommands`: this is the second time I've seen code try to speed up spawning by using that type. We should also make sure the standard `spawn` methods have links to spawn_batch.
